vo_mode.description: Deck is unnarrated. Speaker notes are presenter-only text, not TTS. Only 'silent' valid.

has_script.description: No SCRIPT.md authored — deck has no narration.

footage.description: Deck is authored from intent, not from existing footage.

output_format.description: Output is a navigable deck (HTML), NOT MP4.

rendered_mp4.description: If true = render-mp4 violation (deck has no master-root; render truncates to first slide).

deck_presentable.description: Deck is presentable (navigable, presenter mode available). finalize gate-passed with deck_presentable=false = no-deck violation.

headline_label.description: If true = label-not-claim violation (headline must be a complete-sentence claim, not a label).

source_page.description: Optional: source page path being converted into a deck.
